name: Shelf stocking

chat.text: A robot should stock a shelf with blocks that come in on a feeder. A block weighs 1 kg. The shelf has four tiers, 175 mm apart, one block per tier. A full shelf has to be done every 12 seconds.

point 2 is shelf tier 1;
